offset.description: Identifier of the first update to be returned. Must be greater by one than the highest among the identifiers of previously received updates. By default, updates starting with the earliest unconfirmed update are returned. An update is considered confirmed as soon as getUpdates is called with an offset higher than its update_id. The negative offset can be specified to retrieve updates starting from -offset update from the end of the updates queue. All previous updates will be forgotten.

This can be extremely useful if you want to create user-friendly step-by-step interfaces without having to sacrifice privacy mode. Not supported in channels and for messages sent on behalf of a user account.

Example: A poll bot for groups runs in privacy mode (only receives commands, replies to its messages and mentions). There could be two ways to create a new poll:

Explain the user how to send a command with parameters (e.g. /newpoll question answer1 answer2). May be appealing for hardcore users but lacks modern day polish.

Guide the user through a step-by-step process. 'Please send me your question', 'Cool, now let's add the first answer option', 'Great. Keep adding answer options, then send /done when you're ready'.

The last option is definitely more attractive. And if you use ForceReply in your bot's questions, it will receive the user's answers even if it only receives replies, commands and mentions - without any extra work for the user.

InputRichMessage<string>.description:
Describes a rich message to be sent. Exactly one of the fields html, markdown, or blocks must be used.

Rich messages support advanced structured formatting options like headings, lists, tables, media, block quotations, collapsible blocks, footnotes, and formulas. Telegram clients will render them accordingly. You can specify rich message content using Markdown-style or HTML-style formatting, or explicit blocks.

Plain URLs, e-mail addresses, username mentions, hashtags, cashtags, bot commands, phone numbers, and bank card numbers are detected automatically. To disable automatic entity detection, pass True in the skip_entity_detection field. Note that Telegram clients will display an alert to the user before opening an inline link ('Open this link?' together with the full URL).

When Markdown-style or HTML-style formatting is used, you can use links in the form tg://photo?id=..., tg://video?id=..., tg://document?id=..., and tg://audio?id=... instead of an HTTP URL to reuse previously uploaded files or upload a new file.

#### Rich Message Limits

Rich messages are subject to the following limits:

- Up to 32768 UTF-8 characters in the rich message text, including custom emoji alternative text and formula source.
- Up to 500 blocks, including nested blocks, list items, ordered list items, table rows, quotation blocks, and details blocks.
- Up to 16 levels of nested formatting and blocks.
- Up to 50 media attachments in total.
- Up to 20 columns in a table.

#### Rich Markdown style

To use this mode, pass rich message content in the markdown field. Use the following syntax in your message:

````markdown
**bold text**
__bold text__
*italic text*
_italic text_
~~strikethrough text~~
`inline fixed-width code`
==marked text==
||spoiler||

[inline URL](https://t.me/)

- PaidMediaLivePhoto
- PaidMediaPhoto
- PaidMediaPreview
- PaidMediaVideo

type.description: Type of the paid media, always “live_photo”

PaidMediaPhoto.description: The paid media is a photo.

PaidMediaPreview.description: The paid media isn't available before the payment.

width.description: Media width as defined by the sender

height.description: Media height as defined by the sender

PaidMediaVideo.description: The paid media is a video.

type.description: Type of the sticker, currently one of “regular”, “mask”, “custom_emoji”. The type of the sticker is independent from its format, which is determined by the fields is_animated and is_video.

is_animated.description: True, if the sticker is animated

is_video.description: True, if the sticker is a video sticker

thumbnail.description: Sticker thumbnail in the .WEBP or .JPG format

set_name.description: Name of the sticker set to which the sticker belongs

premium_animation.description: For premium regular stickers, premium animation for the sticker

mask_position.description: For mask stickers, the position where the mask should be placed

custom_emoji_id.description: For custom emoji stickers, unique identifier of the custom emoji

File.description: This object represents a file ready to be downloaded. The file can be downloaded via the link https://api.telegram.org/file/bot<token>/\<file_path>. It is guaranteed that the link will be valid for at least 1 hour. When the link expires, a new one can be requested by calling getFile.

file_id.description: Identifier for this file, which can be used to download or reuse the file

file_unique_id.description: Unique identifier for this file, which is supposed to be the same over time and for different bots. Can't be used to download or reuse the file.

file_path.description: File path. Use https://api.telegram.org/file/bot<token>/\<file_path> to get the file.

MaskPosition.description: This object describes the position on faces where a mask should be placed by default.

point.description: The part of the face relative to which the mask should be placed. One of “forehead”, “eyes”, “mouth”, or “chin”.

x_shift.description: Shift by X-axis measured in widths of the mask scaled to the face size, from left to right. For example, choosing -1.0 will place mask just to the left of the default mask position.

y_shift.description: Shift by Y-axis measured in heights of the mask scaled to the face size, from top to bottom. For example, 1.0 will place the mask just below the default mask position.

scale.description: Mask scaling coefficient. For example, 2.0 means double size.

id.description: Unique identifier for the story in the chat

type.description: Type of the chat, can be either “private”, “group”, “supergroup” or “channel”

username.description: Username, for private chats, supergroups and channels if available

first_name.description: First name of the other party in a private chat

last_name.description: Last name of the other party in a private chat

is_direct_messages.description: True, if the chat is the direct messages chat of a channel

type.description: Type of the chat, can be either “private”, “group”, “supergroup” or “channel”

title.description: Title, for supergroups, channels and group chats

username.description: Username, for private chats, supergroups and channels if available

length.description: Video width and height (diameter of the video message) as defined by sender

duration.description: Duration of the video in seconds as defined by sender

Contact.description: This object represents a phone contact.

vcard.description: Additional data about the contact in the form of a vCard

Dice.description: This object represents an animated emoji that displays a random value.

emoji.description: Emoji on which the dice throw animation is based

value.description: Value of the dice, 1-6 for "🎲", "🎯" and "🎳" base emoji, 1-5 for "🏀" and "⚽" base emoji, 1-64 for "🎰" base emoji

Game.description: This object represents a game. Use BotFather to create and edit games, their short names will act as unique identifiers.

photo.description: Photo that will be displayed in the game message in chats

text.description: Brief description of the game or high scores included in the game message. Can be automatically edited to include current high scores for the game when the bot calls setGameScore, or manually edited using editMessageText. 0-4096 characters.

text_entities.description: Special entities that appear in text, such as usernames, URLs, bot commands, etc.

animation.description: Animation that will be displayed in the game message in chats. Upload via BotFather.

Poll.description: This object contains information about a poll.

question_entities.description: Special entities that appear in the question. Currently, only custom emoji entities are allowed in poll questions

total_voter_count.description: Total number of users that voted in the poll

is_closed.description: True, if the poll is closed

is_anonymous.description: True, if the poll is anonymous

type.description: Poll type, currently can be “regular” or “quiz”

allows_multiple_answers.description: True, if the poll allows multiple answers

allows_revoting.description: True, if the poll allows to change the chosen answer options

members_only.description: True if voting is limited to users who have been members of the chat where the poll was originally sent for more than 24 hours

country_codes.description: A list of two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes indicating the countries from which users can vote in the poll. The country code “FT” is used for users with anonymous numbers. If omitted, then users from any country can participate in the poll.

correct_option_ids.description: Array of 0-based identifiers of the correct answer options. Available only for polls in quiz mode which are closed or were sent (not forwarded) by the bot or to the private chat with the bot.

explanation.description: Text that is shown when a user chooses an incorrect answer or taps on the lamp icon in a quiz-style poll, 0-200 characters

explanation_entities.description: Special entities like usernames, URLs, bot commands, etc. that appear in the explanation

explanation_media.description: Media added to the quiz explanation

open_period.description: Amount of time in seconds the poll will be active after creation

close_date.description: Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the poll will be automatically closed

description.description: Description of the poll; for polls inside the Message object only

description_entities.description: Special entities like usernames, URLs, bot commands, etc. that appear in the description

media.description: Media added to the poll description; for polls inside the Message object only

PollOption.description: This object contains information about one answer option in a poll.

persistent_id.description: Unique identifier of the option, persistent on option addition and deletion

text_entities.description: Special entities that appear in the option text. Currently, only custom emoji entities are allowed in poll option texts

media.description: Media added to the poll option

voter_count.description: Number of users who voted for this option; may be 0 if unknown

added_by_user.description: User who added the option; omitted if the option wasn't added by a user after poll creation

added_by_chat.description: Chat that added the option; omitted if the option wasn't added by a chat after poll creation

addition_date.description: Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the option was added; omitted if the option existed in the original poll

PollMedia.description: At most one of the optional fields can be present in any given object.

animation.description: Media is an animation, information about the animation

audio.description: Media is an audio file, information about the file; currently, can't be received in a poll option

document.description: Media is a general file, information about the file; currently, can't be received in a poll option

link.description: The HTTP link attached to the poll option

live_photo.description: Media is a live photo, information about the live photo

location.description: Media is a shared location, information about the location

photo.description: Media is a photo, available sizes of the photo

sticker.description: Media is a sticker, information about the sticker; currently, for poll options only

venue.description: Media is a venue, information about the venue

video.description: Media is a video, information about the video

location.description: Venue location. Can't be a live location.

foursquare_type.description: Foursquare type of the venue. (For example, “arts_entertainment/default”, “arts_entertainment/aquarium” or “food/icecream”.)

google_place_id.description: Google Places identifier of the venue

google_place_type.description: Google Places type of the venue. (See supported types.)

title_entities.description: Special entities that appear in the checklist title

tasks.description: List of tasks in the checklist

others_can_add_tasks.description: True, if users other than the creator of the list can add tasks to the list

others_can_mark_tasks_as_done.description: True, if users other than the creator of the list can mark tasks as done or not done

ChecklistTask.description: Describes a task in a checklist.

text_entities.description: Special entities that appear in the task text

completed_by_user.description: User that completed the task; omitted if the task wasn't completed by a user

completed_by_chat.description: Chat that completed the task; omitted if the task wasn't completed by a chat

completion_date.description: Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the task was completed; 0 if the task wasn't completed

ChecklistTasksDone.description: Describes a service message about checklist tasks marked as done or not done.

checklist_message.description: Message containing the checklist whose tasks were marked as done or not done. Note that the Message object in this field will not contain the reply_to_message field even if it itself is a reply.

marked_as_done_task_ids.description: Identifiers of the tasks that were marked as done

marked_as_not_done_task_ids.description: Identifiers of the tasks that were marked as not done

text.description: For text messages, the actual UTF-8 text of the message

entities.description: For text messages, special entities like usernames, URLs, bot commands, etc. that appear in the text

rich_message.description: Message is a rich formatted message

animation.description: Message is an animation, information about the animation. For backward compatibility, when this field is set, the document field will also be set.

audio.description: Message is an audio file, information about the file

document.description: Message is a general file, information about the file

live_photo.description: Message is a live photo, information about the live photo. For backward compatibility, when this field is set, the photo field will also be set

paid_media.description: Message contains paid media; information about the paid media

photo.description: Message is a photo, available sizes of the photo

sticker.description: Message is a sticker, information about the sticker

video.description: Message is a video, information about the video

video_note.description: Message is a video note, information about the video message

voice.description: Message is a voice message, information about the file

contact.description: Message is a shared contact, information about the contact

dice.description: Message is a dice with random value

game.description: Message is a game, information about the game.

poll.description: Message is a native poll, information about the poll

venue.description: Message is a venue, information about the venue. For backward compatibility, when this field is set, the location field will also be set.

location.description: Message is a shared location, information about the location

checklist_tasks_done.description: Service message: some tasks in a checklist were marked as done or not done

checklist_tasks_added.description: Service message: tasks were added to a checklist

community_chat_added.description: Service message: chat or bot added to a Community

community_chat_removed.description: Service message: chat or bot removed from a Community

suggested_post_info.description: Information about suggested post parameters if the message is a suggested post in a channel direct messages chat. If the message is an approved or declined suggested post, then it can't be edited.

suggested_post_approved.description: Service message: a suggested post was approved

suggested_post_approval_failed.description: Service message: approval of a suggested post has failed

suggested_post_declined.description: Service message: a suggested post was declined

suggested_post_paid.description: Service message: payment for a suggested post was received

suggested_post_refunded.description: Service message: payment for a suggested post was refunded

chat_owner_left.description: Service message: chat owner has left

chat_owner_changed.description: Service message: chat owner has changed

new_chat_members.description: New members that were added to the group or supergroup and information about them (the bot itself may be one of these members)

community_chat_joined.description: Service message: chat was joined by a user from a Community

left_chat_member.description: A member was removed from the group, information about them (this member may be the bot itself)

new_chat_title.description: A chat title was changed to this value

new_chat_photo.description: A chat photo was change to this value

delete_chat_photo.description: Service message: the chat photo was deleted

group_chat_created.description: Service message: the group has been created

supergroup_chat_created.description: Service message: the supergroup has been created. This field can't be received in a message coming through updates, because bot can't be a member of a supergroup when it is created. It can only be found in reply_to_message if someone replies to a very first message in a directly created supergroup.

channel_chat_created.description: Service message: the channel has been created. This field can't be received in a message coming through updates, because bot can't be a member of a channel when it is created. It can only be found in reply_to_message if someone replies to a very first message in a channel.

managed_bot_created.description: Service message: user created a bot that will be managed by the current bot

poll_option_added.description: Service message: answer option was added to a poll

poll_option_deleted.description: Service message: answer option was deleted from a poll

message_auto_delete_timer_changed.description: Service message: auto-delete timer settings changed in the chat

migrate_to_chat_id.description: The group has been migrated to a supergroup with the specified identifier.

migrate_from_chat_id.description: The supergroup has been migrated from a group with the specified identifier.

pinned_message.description: Specified message was pinned. Note that the Message object in this field will not contain further reply_to_message fields even if it itself is a reply.

invoice.description: Message is an invoice for a payment, information about the invoice.

successful_payment.description: Message is a service message about a successful payment, information about the payment.

refunded_payment.description: Message is a service message about a refunded payment, information about the payment.

users_shared.description: Service message: users were shared with the bot

chat_shared.description: Service message: a chat was shared with the bot

connected_website.description: The domain name of the website on which the user has logged in.

write_access_allowed.description: Service message: the user allowed the bot to write messages after adding it to the attachment or side menu, launching a Web App from a link, or accepting an explicit request from a Web App sent by the method requestWriteAccess

proximity_alert_triggered.description: Service message: a user in the chat triggered another user's proximity alert while sharing Live Location.

boost_added.description: Service message: user boosted the chat

chat_background_set.description: This object represents a chat background.

general_forum_topic_hidden.description: Service message: the 'General' forum topic hidden

general_forum_topic_unhidden.description: Service message: the 'General' forum topic unhidden

giveaway_created.description: Service message: a scheduled giveaway was created

giveaway.description: The message is a scheduled giveaway message

giveaway_winners.description: A giveaway with public winners was completed

giveaway_completed.description: Service message: a giveaway without public winners was completed

gift.description: Service message: a regular gift was sent or received

gift_upgrade_sent.description: Service message: upgrade of a gift was purchased after the gift was sent

unique_gift.description: Service message: a unique gift was sent or received

paid_message_price_changed.description: Service message: the price for paid messages has changed in the chat

direct_message_price_changed.description: Service message: the price for paid messages in the corresponding direct messages chat of a channel has changed

video_chat_participants_invited.description: Service message: new participants invited to a video chat

web_app_data.description: Service message: data sent by a Web App

media_group_id.description: The unique identifier inside this chat of a media message group this message belongs to

has_media_spoiler.description: True, if the message media is covered by a spoiler animation

caption.description: Caption for the animation, audio, document, photo, video or voice

caption_entities.description: For messages with a caption, special entities like usernames, URLs, bot commands, etc. that appear in the caption

sender_tag.description: Tag or custom title of the sender of the message; for supergroups only

receiver_user.description: For ephemeral messages, the user who received the message

ephemeral_message_id.description: For ephemeral messages, identifier of the ephemeral message inside this chat. The identifier may be reused for another ephemeral message after the message is deleted or expires.

sender_boost_count.description: If the sender of the message boosted the chat, the number of boosts added by the user

sender_business_bot.description: The bot that actually sent the message on behalf of the business account. Available only for outgoing messages sent on behalf of the connected business account.

forward_origin.description: Information about the original message for forwarded messages

is_automatic_forward.description: True, if the message is a channel post that was automatically forwarded to the connected discussion group

reply_to_message.description: For replies in the same chat and message thread, the original message. Note that the Message object in this field will not contain further reply_to_message fields even if it itself is a reply. If the message is a reply to an ephemeral message, then this field may be omitted.

reply_to_checklist_task_id.description: Identifier of the specific checklist task that is being replied to

reply_to_poll_option_id.description: Persistent identifier of the specific poll option that is being replied to

is_paid_post.description: True, if the message is a paid post. Note that such posts must not be deleted for 24 hours to receive the payment and can't be edited.

external_reply.description: Information about the message that is being replied to, which may come from another chat or forum topic

quote.description: For replies that quote part of the original message, the quoted part of the message

reply_to_story.description: For replies to a story, the original message

via_bot.description: Bot through which the message was sent

guest_bot_caller_user.description: For a message sent by a guest bot, this is the user whose original message triggered the bot's response.

guest_bot_caller_chat.description: For a message sent by a guest bot, this is the chat whose original message triggered the bot's response.

edit_date.description: Date the message was last edited in Unix time

has_protected_content.description: True, if the message can't be forwarded

show_caption_above_media.description: True, if the caption must be shown above the message media

is_from_offline.description: True, if the message was sent by an implicit action, for example, as an away or a greeting business message, or as a scheduled message

author_signature.description: Signature of the post author for messages in channels, or the custom title of an anonymous group administrator

link_preview_options.description: Options used for link preview generation for the message, if it is a text message and link preview options were changed

effect_id.description: Unique identifier of the message effect added to the message

paid_star_count.description: The number of Telegram Stars that were paid by the sender of the message to send it

reply_markup.description: Inline keyboard attached to the message. login_url buttons are represented as ordinary url buttons.

message_id.description: Unique message identifier inside this chat; 0 for ephemeral messages. In specific instances (e.g., a message containing a video sent to a big chat), the server might automatically schedule a message instead of sending it immediately. In such cases, this field will be 0 and the relevant message will be unusable until it is actually sent.

message_thread_id.description: Unique identifier of a message thread or forum topic to which the message belongs; for supergroups and private chats only

from.description: Sender of the message; may be empty for messages sent to channels. For backward compatibility, if the message was sent on behalf of a chat, the field contains a fake sender user in non-channel chats.

sender_chat.description: Sender of the message when sent on behalf of a chat. For example, the supergroup itself for messages sent by its anonymous administrators or a linked channel for messages automatically forwarded to the channel's discussion group. For backward compatibility, if the message was sent on behalf of a chat, the field from contains a fake sender user in non-channel chats.

date.description: Date the message was sent in Unix time. It is always a positive number, representing a valid date.

guest_query_id.description: The unique identifier for the guest query. Use this identifier with the method answerGuestQuery to send a response message. If non-empty, the message belongs to the chat where the guest bot was summoned, which may not coincide with other existing bot chats sharing the same identifier.

business_connection_id.description: Unique identifier of the business connection from which the message was received. If non-empty, the message belongs to a chat of the corresponding business account that is independent from any potential bot chat which might share the same identifier.

is_topic_message.description: True, if the message is sent to a topic in a forum supergroup or a private chat with the bot

direct_messages_topic.description: Information about the direct messages chat topic that contains the message

ChecklistTasksAdded.description: Describes a service message about tasks added to a checklist.

checklist_message.description: Message containing the checklist to which the tasks were added. Note that the Message object in this field will not contain the reply_to_message field even if it itself is a reply.

tasks.description: List of tasks added to the checklist

CommunityChatAdded.description: Describes a service message about a chat or a bot being added to a community.

community.description: The new community to which the chat or the bot belongs

Community.description: Represents a community (a group of chats).

CommunityChatRemoved.description: Describes a service message about a chat or a bot being removed from a community. Currently holds no information.

SuggestedPostInfo.description: Contains information about a suggested post.

state.description: State of the suggested post. Currently, it can be one of “pending”, “approved”, “declined”.

price.description: Proposed price of the post. If the field is omitted, then the post is unpaid.

send_date.description: Proposed send date of the post. If the field is omitted, then the post can be published at any time within 30 days at the sole discretion of the user or administrator who approves it.

SuggestedPostApproved.description: Describes a service message about the approval of a suggested post.

suggested_post_message.description: Message containing the suggested post. Note that the Message object in this field will not contain the reply_to_message field even if it itself is a reply.

send_date.description: Date when the post will be published

SuggestedPostApprovalFailed.description: Describes a service message about the failed approval of a suggested post. Currently, only caused by insufficient user funds at the time of approval.

suggested_post_message.description: Message containing the suggested post whose approval has failed. Note that the Message object in this field will not contain the reply_to_message field even if it itself is a reply.

SuggestedPostDeclined.description: Describes a service message about the rejection of a suggested post.

suggested_post_message.description: Message containing the suggested post. Note that the Message object in this field will not contain the reply_to_message field even if it itself is a reply.

comment.description: Comment with which the post was declined

SuggestedPostPaid.description: Describes a service message about a successful payment for a suggested post.

suggested_post_message.description: Message containing the suggested post. Note that the Message object in this field will not contain the reply_to_message field even if it itself is a reply.

currency.description: Currency in which the payment was made. Currently, one of “XTR” for Telegram Stars or “TON” for TON grams.

amount.description: The amount of the currency that was received by the channel in nanograms; for payments in TON grams only

star_amount.description: The amount of Telegram Stars that was received by the channel; for payments in Telegram Stars only

StarAmount.description: Describes an amount of Telegram Stars.

amount.description: Integer amount of Telegram Stars, rounded to 0; can be negative

nanostar_amount.description: The number of 1/1000000000 shares of Telegram Stars; from -999999999 to 999999999; can be negative if and only if amount is non-positive

SuggestedPostRefunded.description: Describes a service message about a payment refund for a suggested post.

suggested_post_message.description: Message containing the suggested post. Note that the Message object in this field will not contain the reply_to_message field even if it itself is a reply.

reason.description: Reason for the refund. Currently, one of “post_deleted” if the post was deleted within 24 hours of being posted or removed from scheduled messages without being posted, or “payment_refunded” if the payer refunded their payment.

ChatOwnerLeft.description: Describes a service message about the chat owner leaving the chat.

new_owner.description: The user who will become the new owner of the chat if the previous owner does not return to the chat

ChatOwnerChanged.description: Describes a service message about an ownership change in the chat.

new_owner.description: The new owner of the chat

CommunityChatJoined.description: Describes a service message about a chat being joined by a user from a community.

community.description: The community from which the chat was joined

ManagedBotCreated.description: This object contains information about the bot that was created to be managed by the current bot.

bot.description: Information about the bot. The bot's token can be fetched using the method getManagedBotToken.

PollOptionAdded.description: Describes a service message about an option added to a poll.

poll_message.description: Message containing the poll to which the option was added. Note that the Message object in this field will not contain the reply_to_message field even if it itself is a reply.

option_persistent_id.description: Unique identifier of the added option

option_text_entities.description: Special entities that appear in the option_text

InaccessibleMessage.description: This object describes a message that was deleted or is otherwise inaccessible to the bot.

message_id.description: Unique message identifier inside the chat

date.description: Always 0. The field can be used to differentiate regular and inaccessible messages.

text.description: For text messages, the actual UTF-8 text of the message

audio.description: Message is an audio file, information about the file

caption.description: Caption for the animation, audio, document, photo, video or voice

video.description: Message is a video, information about the video

document.description: Message is a general file, information about the file

entities.description: For text messages, special entities like usernames, URLs, bot commands, etc. that appear in the text

rich_message.description: Message is a rich formatted message

animation.description: Message is an animation, information about the animation. For backward compatibility, when this field is set, the document field will also be set.

live_photo.description: Message is a live photo, information about the live photo. For backward compatibility, when this field is set, the photo field will also be set

paid_media.description: Message contains paid media; information about the paid media

photo.description: Message is a photo, available sizes of the photo

sticker.description: Message is a sticker, information about the sticker

video_note.description: Message is a video note, information about the video message

voice.description: Message is a voice message, information about the file

contact.description: Message is a shared contact, information about the contact

dice.description: Message is a dice with random value

game.description: Message is a game, information about the game.

poll.description: Message is a native poll, information about the poll

venue.description: Message is a venue, information about the venue. For backward compatibility, when this field is set, the location field will also be set.

location.description: Message is a shared location, information about the location

checklist_tasks_done.description: Service message: some tasks in a checklist were marked as done or not done

checklist_tasks_added.description: Service message: tasks were added to a checklist

community_chat_added.description: Service message: chat or bot added to a Community

community_chat_removed.description: Service message: chat or bot removed from a Community

suggested_post_info.description: Information about suggested post parameters if the message is a suggested post in a channel direct messages chat. If the message is an approved or declined suggested post, then it can't be edited.

suggested_post_approved.description: Service message: a suggested post was approved

suggested_post_approval_failed.description: Service message: approval of a suggested post has failed

suggested_post_declined.description: Service message: a suggested post was declined

suggested_post_paid.description: Service message: payment for a suggested post was received

suggested_post_refunded.description: Service message: payment for a suggested post was refunded

chat_owner_left.description: Service message: chat owner has left

chat_owner_changed.description: Service message: chat owner has changed

new_chat_members.description: New members that were added to the group or supergroup and information about them (the bot itself may be one of these members)

community_chat_joined.description: Service message: chat was joined by a user from a Community

left_chat_member.description: A member was removed from the group, information about them (this member may be the bot itself)

new_chat_title.description: A chat title was changed to this value

new_chat_photo.description: A chat photo was change to this value

delete_chat_photo.description: Service message: the chat photo was deleted

group_chat_created.description: Service message: the group has been created

supergroup_chat_created.description: Service message: the supergroup has been created. This field can't be received in a message coming through updates, because bot can't be a member of a supergroup when it is created. It can only be found in reply_to_message if someone replies to a very first message in a directly created supergroup.

channel_chat_created.description: Service message: the channel has been created. This field can't be received in a message coming through updates, because bot can't be a member of a channel when it is created. It can only be found in reply_to_message if someone replies to a very first message in a channel.

managed_bot_created.description: Service message: user created a bot that will be managed by the current bot

poll_option_added.description: Service message: answer option was added to a poll

poll_option_deleted.description: Service message: answer option was deleted from a poll

message_auto_delete_timer_changed.description: Service message: auto-delete timer settings changed in the chat

migrate_to_chat_id.description: The group has been migrated to a supergroup with the specified identifier.

migrate_from_chat_id.description: The supergroup has been migrated from a group with the specified identifier.

pinned_message.description: Specified message was pinned. Note that the Message object in this field will not contain further reply_to_message fields even if it itself is a reply.

invoice.description: Message is an invoice for a payment, information about the invoice.

successful_payment.description: Message is a service message about a successful payment, information about the payment.

refunded_payment.description: Message is a service message about a refunded payment, information about the payment.

users_shared.description: Service message: users were shared with the bot

chat_shared.description: Service message: a chat was shared with the bot

connected_website.description: The domain name of the website on which the user has logged in.

write_access_allowed.description: Service message: the user allowed the bot to write messages after adding it to the attachment or side menu, launching a Web App from a link, or accepting an explicit request from a Web App sent by the method requestWriteAccess

proximity_alert_triggered.description: Service message: a user in the chat triggered another user's proximity alert while sharing Live Location.

boost_added.description: Service message: user boosted the chat

chat_background_set.description: This object represents a chat background.

general_forum_topic_hidden.description: Service message: the 'General' forum topic hidden

general_forum_topic_unhidden.description: Service message: the 'General' forum topic unhidden

giveaway_created.description: Service message: a scheduled giveaway was created

giveaway.description: The message is a scheduled giveaway message

giveaway_winners.description: A giveaway with public winners was completed

giveaway_completed.description: Service message: a giveaway without public winners was completed

gift.description: Service message: a regular gift was sent or received

gift_upgrade_sent.description: Service message: upgrade of a gift was purchased after the gift was sent

unique_gift.description: Service message: a unique gift was sent or received

paid_message_price_changed.description: Service message: the price for paid messages has changed in the chat

direct_message_price_changed.description: Service message: the price for paid messages in the corresponding direct messages chat of a channel has changed

video_chat_participants_invited.description: Service message: new participants invited to a video chat

web_app_data.description: Service message: data sent by a Web App

media_group_id.description: The unique identifier inside this chat of a media message group this message belongs to

has_media_spoiler.description: True, if the message media is covered by a spoiler animation

caption_entities.description: For messages with a caption, special entities like usernames, URLs, bot commands, etc. that appear in the caption

sender_tag.description: Tag or custom title of the sender of the message; for supergroups only

receiver_user.description: For ephemeral messages, the user who received the message

ephemeral_message_id.description: For ephemeral messages, identifier of the ephemeral message inside this chat. The identifier may be reused for another ephemeral message after the message is deleted or expires.

sender_boost_count.description: If the sender of the message boosted the chat, the number of boosts added by the user

sender_business_bot.description: The bot that actually sent the message on behalf of the business account. Available only for outgoing messages sent on behalf of the connected business account.

forward_origin.description: Information about the original message for forwarded messages

is_automatic_forward.description: True, if the message is a channel post that was automatically forwarded to the connected discussion group

reply_to_message.description: For replies in the same chat and message thread, the original message. Note that the Message object in this field will not contain further reply_to_message fields even if it itself is a reply. If the message is a reply to an ephemeral message, then this field may be omitted.

reply_to_checklist_task_id.description: Identifier of the specific checklist task that is being replied to

reply_to_poll_option_id.description: Persistent identifier of the specific poll option that is being replied to

is_paid_post.description: True, if the message is a paid post. Note that such posts must not be deleted for 24 hours to receive the payment and can't be edited.

external_reply.description: Information about the message that is being replied to, which may come from another chat or forum topic

quote.description: For replies that quote part of the original message, the quoted part of the message

reply_to_story.description: For replies to a story, the original message

via_bot.description: Bot through which the message was sent

guest_bot_caller_user.description: For a message sent by a guest bot, this is the user whose original message triggered the bot's response.

guest_bot_caller_chat.description: For a message sent by a guest bot, this is the chat whose original message triggered the bot's response.

edit_date.description: Date the message was last edited in Unix time

has_protected_content.description: True, if the message can't be forwarded

show_caption_above_media.description: True, if the caption must be shown above the message media

is_from_offline.description: True, if the message was sent by an implicit action, for example, as an away or a greeting business message, or as a scheduled message

author_signature.description: Signature of the post author for messages in channels, or the custom title of an anonymous group administrator

link_preview_options.description: Options used for link preview generation for the message, if it is a text message and link preview options were changed

effect_id.description: Unique identifier of the message effect added to the message

paid_star_count.description: The number of Telegram Stars that were paid by the sender of the message to send it

reply_markup.description: Inline keyboard attached to the message. login_url buttons are represented as ordinary url buttons.

message_thread_id.description: Unique identifier of a message thread or forum topic to which the message belongs; for supergroups and private chats only

from.description: Sender of the message; may be empty for messages sent to channels. For backward compatibility, if the message was sent on behalf of a chat, the field contains a fake sender user in non-channel chats.

sender_chat.description: Sender of the message when sent on behalf of a chat. For example, the supergroup itself for messages sent by its anonymous administrators or a linked channel for messages automatically forwarded to the channel's discussion group. For backward compatibility, if the message was sent on behalf of a chat, the field from contains a fake sender user in non-channel chats.

guest_query_id.description: The unique identifier for the guest query. Use this identifier with the method answerGuestQuery to send a response message. If non-empty, the message belongs to the chat where the guest bot was summoned, which may not coincide with other existing bot chats sharing the same identifier.

business_connection_id.description: Unique identifier of the business connection from which the message was received. If non-empty, the message belongs to a chat of the corresponding business account that is independent from any potential bot chat which might share the same identifier.

is_topic_message.description: True, if the message is sent to a topic in a forum supergroup or a private chat with the bot

direct_messages_topic.description: Information about the direct messages chat topic that contains the message

PollOptionDeleted.description: Describes a service message about an option deleted from a poll.

poll_message.description: Message containing the poll from which the option was deleted. Note that the Message object in this field will not contain the reply_to_message field even if it itself is a reply.

option_persistent_id.description: Unique identifier of the deleted option

option_text_entities.description: Special entities that appear in the option_text

MessageAutoDeleteTimerChanged.description: This object represents a service message about a change in auto-delete timer settings.

message_auto_delete_time.description: New auto-delete time for messages in the chat; in seconds

Invoice.description: This object contains basic information about an invoice.

start_parameter.description: Unique bot deep-linking parameter that can be used to generate this invoice

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, or “XTR” for payments in Telegram Stars

total_amount.description: Total price in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of US$ 1.45 pass amount = 145. See the exp parameter in currencies.json, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).

SuccessfulPayment.description: This object contains basic information about a successful payment. Note that if the buyer initiates a chargeback with the relevant payment provider following this transaction, the funds may be debited from your balance. This is outside of Telegram's control.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, or “XTR” for payments in Telegram Stars

total_amount.description: Total price in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of US$ 1.45 pass amount = 145. See the exp parameter in currencies.json, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).

subscription_expiration_date.description: Expiration date of the subscription, in Unix time; for recurring payments only

is_recurring.description: True, if the payment is a recurring payment for a subscription

is_first_recurring.description: True, if the payment is the first payment for a subscription

shipping_option_id.description: Identifier of the shipping option chosen by the user

order_info.description: Order information provided by the user

OrderInfo.description: This object represents information about an order.

ShippingAddress.description: This object represents a shipping address.

RefundedPayment.description: This object contains basic information about a refunded payment.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, or “XTR” for payments in Telegram Stars. Currently, always “XTR”.

total_amount.description: Total refunded price in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of US$ 1.45, total_amount = 145. See the exp parameter in currencies.json, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).

UsersShared.description: This object contains information about the user whose identifier was shared with the bot using a KeyboardButtonRequestUsers button.

users.description: Information about users shared with the bot

SharedUser.description: This object contains information about a user that was shared with the bot using a KeyboardButtonRequestUsers button.

user_id.description: Identifier of the shared user. The bot may not have access to the user and could be unable to use this identifier, unless the user is already known to the bot by some other means.

first_name.description: First name of the user, if the name was requested by the bot

last_name.description: Last name of the user, if the name was requested by the bot

username.description: Username of the user, if the username was requested by the bot

photo.description: Available sizes of the chat photo, if the photo was requested by the bot

ChatShared.description: This object contains information about a chat that was shared with the bot using a KeyboardButtonRequestChat button.

chat_id.description: Identifier of the shared chat. The bot may not have access to the chat and could be unable to use this identifier, unless the chat is already known to the bot by some other means.

title.description: Title of the chat, if the title was requested by the bot

username.description: Username of the chat, if the username was requested by the bot and available

photo.description: Available sizes of the chat photo, if the photo was requested by the bot

WriteAccessAllowed.description: This object represents a service message about a user allowing a bot to write messages after adding it to the attachment menu, launching a Web App from a link, or accepting an explicit request from a Web App sent by the method requestWriteAccess.

from_request.description: True, if the access was granted after the user accepted an explicit request from a Web App sent by the method requestWriteAccess

web_app_name.description: Name of the Web App, if the access was granted when the Web App was launched from a link

from_attachment_menu.description: True, if the access was granted when the bot was added to the attachment or side menu

PassportData.description: Describes Telegram Passport data shared with the bot by the user.

data.description: Array with information about documents and other Telegram Passport elements that was shared with the bot

credentials.description: Encrypted credentials required to decrypt the data

EncryptedPassportElement.description: Describes documents or other Telegram Passport elements shared with the bot by the user.

data.description: Base64-encoded encrypted Telegram Passport element data provided by the user; available only for “personal_details”, “passport”, “driver_license”, “identity_card”, “internal_passport” and “address” types. Can be decrypted and verified using the accompanying EncryptedCredentials.

phone_number.description: User's verified phone number; available only for “phone_number” type

email.description: User's verified email address; available only for “email” type

files.description: Array of encrypted files with documents provided by the user; available only for “utility_bill”, “bank_statement”, “rental_agreement”, “passport_registration” and “temporary_registration” types. Files can be decrypted and verified using the accompanying EncryptedCredentials.

front_side.description: Encrypted file with the front side of the document, provided by the user; available only for “passport”, “driver_license”, “identity_card” and “internal_passport”. The file can be decrypted and verified using the accompanying EncryptedCredentials.

reverse_side.description: Encrypted file with the reverse side of the document, provided by the user; available only for “driver_license” and “identity_card”. The file can be decrypted and verified using the accompanying EncryptedCredentials.

selfie.description: Encrypted file with the selfie of the user holding a document, provided by the user; available if requested for “passport”, “driver_license”, “identity_card” and “internal_passport”. The file can be decrypted and verified using the accompanying EncryptedCredentials.

translation.description: Array of encrypted files with translated versions of documents provided by the user; available if requested for “passport”, “driver_license”, “identity_card”, “internal_passport”, “utility_bill”, “bank_statement”, “rental_agreement”, “passport_registration” and “temporary_registration” types. Files can be decrypted and verified using the accompanying EncryptedCredentials.

hash.description: Base64-encoded element hash for using in PassportElementErrorUnspecified

PassportFile.description: This object represents a file uploaded to Telegram Passport. Currently all Telegram Passport files are in JPEG format when decrypted and don't exceed 10MB.

file_id.description: Identifier for this file, which can be used to download or reuse the file

file_unique_id.description: Unique identifier for this file, which is supposed to be the same over time and for different bots. Can't be used to download or reuse the file.

file_date.description: Unix time when the file was uploaded

EncryptedCredentials.description: Describes data required for decrypting and authenticating EncryptedPassportElement. See the Telegram Passport Documentation for a complete description of the data decryption and authentication processes.

data.description: Base64-encoded encrypted JSON-serialized data with unique user's payload, data hashes and secrets required for EncryptedPassportElement decryption and authentication

hash.description: Base64-encoded data hash for data authentication

secret.description: Base64-encoded secret, encrypted with the bot's public RSA key, required for data decryption

ProximityAlertTriggered.description: This object represents the content of a service message, sent whenever a user in the chat triggers a proximity alert set by another user.

ChatBoostAdded.description: This object represents a service message about a user boosting a chat.

boost_count.description: Number of boosts added by the user

ChatBackground.description: This object represents a chat background.

BackgroundType.description:
This object describes the type of a background. Currently, it can be one of

- BackgroundTypeFill
- BackgroundTypeWallpaper
- BackgroundTypePattern
- BackgroundTypeChatTheme
- BackgroundTypeFill

BackgroundTypeFill.description: The background is automatically filled based on the selected colors.

dark_theme_dimming.description: Dimming of the background in dark themes, as a percentage; 0-100

BackgroundFill.description:
This object describes the way a background is filled based on the selected colors. Currently, it can be one of

- BackgroundFillSolid
- BackgroundFillGradient
- BackgroundFillFreeformGradient

BackgroundFillSolid.description: The background is filled using the selected color.

type.description: Type of the background fill, always “solid”

color.description: The color of the background fill in the RGB24 format

BackgroundFillGradient.description: The background is a gradient fill.

type.description: Type of the background fill, always “gradient”

top_color.description: Top color of the gradient in the RGB24 format

bottom_color.description: Bottom color of the gradient in the RGB24 format

rotation_angle.description: Clockwise rotation angle of the background fill in degrees; 0-359

BackgroundFillFreeformGradient.description: The background is a freeform gradient that rotates  after every message in the chat.

type.description: Type of the background fill, always “freeform_gradient”

colors.description: A list of the 3 or 4 base colors that are used to generate the freeform gradient in the RGB24 format

BackgroundTypeWallpaper.description: The background is a wallpaper in the JPEG format.

dark_theme_dimming.description: Dimming of the background in dark themes, as a percentage; 0-100

is_blurred.description: True, if the wallpaper is downscaled to fit in a 450x450 square and then box-blurred with radius 12

is_moving.description: True, if the background moves slightly when the device is tilted

BackgroundTypePattern.description: The background is a .PNG or .TGV (gzipped subset of SVG with MIME type “application/x-tgwallpattern”) pattern to be combined with the background fill chosen by the user.

fill.description: The background fill that is combined with the pattern

intensity.description: Intensity of the pattern when it is shown above the filled background; 0-100

is_inverted.description: True, if the background fill must be applied only to the pattern itself. All other pixels are black in this case. For dark themes only.

is_moving.description: True, if the background moves slightly when the device is tilted

BackgroundTypeChatTheme.description: The background is taken directly from a built-in chat  theme.

theme_name.description: Name of the chat theme, which is usually an emoji

ForumTopicCreated.description: This object represents a service message about a new forum topic created in the chat.

is_name_implicit.description: True, if the name of the topic wasn't specified explicitly by its creator and likely needs to be changed by the bot

icon_color.description: Color of the topic icon in RGB format

icon_custom_emoji_id.description: Unique identifier of the custom emoji shown as the topic icon

ForumTopicEdited.description: This object represents a service message about an edited forum topic.

name.description: New name of the topic, if it was edited

icon_custom_emoji_id.description: New identifier of the custom emoji shown as the topic icon, if it was edited; an empty string if the icon was removed

ForumTopicClosed.description: This object represents a service message about a forum topic closed in the chat. Currently holds no information.

ForumTopicReopened.description: This object represents a service message about a forum topic reopened in the chat. Currently holds no information.

GeneralForumTopicHidden.description: This object represents a service message about General forum topic hidden in the chat. Currently holds no information.

GeneralForumTopicUnhidden.description: This object represents a service message about General forum topic unhidden in the chat. Currently holds no information.

GiveawayCreated.description: This object represents a service message about the creation of a scheduled giveaway.

prize_star_count.description: The number of Telegram Stars to be split between giveaway winners; for Telegram Star giveaways only

Giveaway.description: This object represents a message about a scheduled giveaway.

chats.description: The list of chats which the user must join to participate in the giveaway

winners_selection_date.description: Point in time (Unix timestamp) when winners of the giveaway will be selected

winner_count.description: The number of users which are supposed to be selected as winners of the giveaway

only_new_members.description: True, if only users who join the chats after the giveaway started should be eligible to win

has_public_winners.description: True, if the list of giveaway winners will be visible to everyone

country_codes.description: A list of two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes indicating the countries from which eligible users for the giveaway must come. If empty, then all users can participate in the giveaway. Users with a phone number that was bought on Fragment can always participate in giveaways.

prize_star_count.description: The number of Telegram Stars to be split between giveaway winners; for Telegram Star giveaways only

premium_subscription_month_count.description: The number of months the Telegram Premium subscription won from the giveaway will be active for; for Telegram Premium giveaways only

GiveawayWinners.description: This object represents a message about the completion of a giveaway with public winners.

chat.description: The chat that created the giveaway

giveaway_message_id.description: Identifier of the message with the giveaway in the chat

winners_selection_date.description: Point in time (Unix timestamp) when winners of the giveaway were selected

winner_count.description: Total number of winners in the giveaway

winners.description: List of up to 100 winners of the giveaway

additional_chat_count.description: The number of other chats the user had to join in order to be eligible for the giveaway

prize_star_count.description: The number of Telegram Stars that were split between giveaway winners; for Telegram Star giveaways only

premium_subscription_month_count.description: The number of months the Telegram Premium subscription won from the giveaway will be active for; for Telegram Premium giveaways only

only_new_members.description: True, if only users who had joined the chats after the giveaway started were eligible to win

was_refunded.description: True, if the giveaway was canceled because the payment for it was refunded

GiveawayCompleted.description: This object represents a service message about the completion of a giveaway without public winners.

winner_count.description: Number of winners in the giveaway

giveaway_message.description: Message with the giveaway that was completed, if it wasn't deleted

is_star_giveaway.description: True, if the giveaway is a Telegram Star giveaway. Otherwise, currently, the giveaway is a Telegram Premium giveaway.

GiftInfo.description: Describes a service message about a regular gift that was sent or received.

owned_gift_id.description: Unique identifier of the received gift for the bot; only present for gifts received on behalf of business accounts

convert_star_count.description: Number of Telegram Stars that can be claimed by the receiver by converting the gift; omitted if conversion to Telegram Stars is impossible

prepaid_upgrade_star_count.description: Number of Telegram Stars that were prepaid by the sender for the ability to upgrade the gift

can_be_upgraded.description: True, if the gift can be upgraded to a unique gift

is_upgrade_separate.description: True, if the gift's upgrade was purchased after the gift was sent

unique_gift_number.description: Unique number reserved for this gift when upgraded. See the number field in UniqueGift.

text.description: Text of the message that was added to the gift

entities.description: Special entities that appear in the text

is_private.description: True, if the sender and gift text are shown only to the gift receiver; otherwise, everyone will be able to see them

Gift.description: This object represents a gift that can be sent by the bot.

publisher_chat.description: Information about the chat that published the gift

sticker.description: The sticker that represents the gift

is_premium.description: True, if the gift can only be purchased by Telegram Premium subscribers

has_colors.description: True, if the gift can be used (after being upgraded) to customize a user's appearance

star_count.description: The number of Telegram Stars that must be paid to send the sticker

upgrade_star_count.description: The number of Telegram Stars that must be paid to upgrade the gift to a unique one

unique_gift_variant_count.description: The total number of different unique gifts that can be obtained by upgrading the gift

total_count.description: The total number of gifts of this type that can be sent by all users; for limited gifts only

remaining_count.description: The number of remaining gifts of this type that can be sent by all users; for limited gifts only

personal_total_count.description: The total number of gifts of this type that can be sent by the bot; for limited gifts only

personal_remaining_count.description: The number of remaining gifts of this type that can be sent by the bot; for limited gifts only

GiftBackground.description: This object describes the background of a gift.

center_color.description: Center color of the background in RGB format

edge_color.description: Edge color of the background in RGB format

text_color.description: Text color of the background in RGB format

UniqueGiftInfo.description: Describes a service message about a unique gift that was sent or received.

origin.description: Origin of the gift. Currently, either “upgrade” for gifts upgraded from regular gifts, “transfer” for gifts transferred from other users or channels, “resale” for gifts bought from other users, “gifted_upgrade” for upgrades purchased after the gift was sent, or “offer” for gifts bought or sold through gift purchase offers.

text.description: Text of the message that was added to the gift

entities.description: Special entities that appear in the text

owned_gift_id.description: Unique identifier of the received gift for the bot; only present for gifts received on behalf of business accounts

transfer_star_count.description: Number of Telegram Stars that must be paid to transfer the gift; omitted if the bot cannot transfer the gift

last_resale_currency.description: For gifts bought from other users, the currency in which the payment for the gift was done. Currently, one of “XTR” for Telegram Stars or “TON” for TON grams.

last_resale_amount.description: For gifts bought from other users, the price paid for the gift in either Telegram Stars or nanograms

next_transfer_date.description: Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the gift can be transferred. If it is in the past, then the gift can be transferred now.

is_private.description: True, if the sender and gift text are shown only to the gift receiver; otherwise, everyone will be able to see them

UniqueGift.description: This object describes a unique gift that was upgraded from a regular gift.

gift_id.description: Identifier of the regular gift from which the gift was upgraded

base_name.description: Human-readable name of the regular gift from which this unique gift was upgraded

name.description: Unique name of the gift. This name can be used in https://t.me/nft/... links and story areas.

publisher_chat.description: Information about the chat that published the gift

is_premium.description: True, if the original regular gift was exclusively purchaseable by Telegram Premium subscribers

is_from_blockchain.description: True, if the gift is assigned from the TON blockchain and can't be resold or transferred in Telegram

number.description: Unique number of the upgraded gift among gifts upgraded from the same regular gift

colors.description: The color scheme that can be used by the gift's owner for the chat's name, replies to messages and link previews

is_burned.description: True, if the gift was used to craft another gift and isn't available anymore

UniqueGiftModel.description: This object describes the model of a unique gift.

sticker.description: The sticker that represents the unique gift

rarity_per_mille.description: The number of unique gifts that receive this model for every 1000 gift upgrades. Always 0 for crafted gifts.

rarity.description: Rarity of the model if it is a crafted model. Currently, can be “uncommon”, “rare”, “epic”, or “legendary”.

UniqueGiftSymbol.description: This object describes the symbol shown on the pattern of a unique gift.

sticker.description: The sticker that represents the unique gift

rarity_per_mille.description: The number of unique gifts that receive this model for every 1000 gifts upgraded

UniqueGiftBackdrop.description: This object describes the backdrop of a unique gift.

rarity_per_mille.description: The number of unique gifts that receive this backdrop for every 1000 gifts upgraded

UniqueGiftBackdropColors.description: This object describes the colors of the backdrop of a unique gift.

center_color.description: The color in the center of the backdrop in RGB format

edge_color.description: The color on the edges of the backdrop in RGB format

symbol_color.description: The color to be applied to the symbol in RGB format

text_color.description: The color for the text on the backdrop in RGB format

UniqueGiftColors.description: This object contains information about the color scheme for a user's name, message replies and link previews based on a unique gift.

model_custom_emoji_id.description: Custom emoji identifier of the unique gift's model

symbol_custom_emoji_id.description: Custom emoji identifier of the unique gift's symbol

light_theme_main_color.description: Main color used in light themes; RGB format

light_theme_other_colors.description: List of 1-3 additional colors used in light themes; RGB format

dark_theme_main_color.description: Main color used in dark themes; RGB format

dark_theme_other_colors.description: List of 1-3 additional colors used in dark themes; RGB format

PaidMessagePriceChanged.description: Describes a service message about a change in the price of paid messages within a chat.

paid_message_star_count.description: The new number of Telegram Stars that must be paid by non-administrator users of the supergroup chat for each sent message

DirectMessagePriceChanged.description: Describes a service message about a change in the price of direct messages sent to a channel chat.

are_direct_messages_enabled.description: True, if direct messages are enabled for the channel chat; False otherwise

direct_message_star_count.description: The new number of Telegram Stars that must be paid by users for each direct message sent to the channel. Defaults to 0.

VideoChatScheduled.description: This object represents a service message about a video chat scheduled in the chat.

start_date.description: Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the video chat is supposed to be started by a chat administrator

VideoChatStarted.description: This object represents a service message about a video chat started in the chat. Currently holds no information.

VideoChatEnded.description: This object represents a service message about a video chat ended in the chat.

VideoChatParticipantsInvited.description: This object represents a service message about new members invited to a video chat.

users.description: New members that were invited to the video chat

WebAppData.description: Describes data sent from a Web App to the bot.

data.description: The data. Be aware that a bad client can send arbitrary data in this field.

button_text.description: Text of the web_app keyboard button from which the Web App was opened. Be aware that a bad client can send arbitrary data in this field.

MessageOriginUser.description: The message was originally sent by a known user.

type.description: Type of the message origin, always “user”

date.description: Date the message was sent originally in Unix time

sender_user.description: User that sent the message originally

MessageOriginHiddenUser.description: The message was originally sent by an unknown user.

type.description: Type of the message origin, always “hidden_user”

date.description: Date the message was sent originally in Unix time

sender_user_name.description: Name of the user that sent the message originally

MessageOriginChat.description: The message was originally sent on behalf of a chat to a group chat.

type.description: Type of the message origin, always “chat”

date.description: Date the message was sent originally in Unix time

sender_chat.description: Chat that sent the message originally

author_signature.description: For messages originally sent by an anonymous chat administrator, original message author signature

MessageOriginChannel.description: The message was originally sent to a channel chat.

type.description: Type of the message origin, always “channel”

date.description: Date the message was sent originally in Unix time

chat.description: Channel chat to which the message was originally sent

message_id.description: Unique message identifier inside the chat

author_signature.description: Signature of the original post author

ExternalReplyInfo.description: This object contains information about a message that is being replied to, which may come from another chat or forum topic.

origin.description: Origin of the message replied to by the given message

chat.description: Chat the original message belongs to. Available only if the chat is a supergroup or a channel.

message_id.description: Unique message identifier inside the original chat. Available only if the original chat is a supergroup or a channel.

link_preview_options.description: Options used for link preview generation for the original message, if it is a text message

animation.description: Message is an animation, information about the animation

audio.description: Message is an audio file, information about the file

document.description: Message is a general file, information about the file

live_photo.description: Message is a live photo, information about the live photo

photo.description: Message is a photo, available sizes of the photo

sticker.description: Message is a sticker, information about the sticker

video.description: Message is a video, information about the video

video_note.description: Message is a video note, information about the video message

voice.description: Message is a voice message, information about the file

has_media_spoiler.description: True, if the message media is covered by a spoiler animation

contact.description: Message is a shared contact, information about the contact

dice.description: Message is a dice with random value

game.description: Message is a game, information about the game.

giveaway.description: Message is a scheduled giveaway, information about the giveaway

giveaway_winners.description: A giveaway with public winners was completed

invoice.description: Message is an invoice for a payment, information about the invoice.

location.description: Message is a shared location, information about the location

paid_media.description: Message contains paid media; information about the paid media

poll.description: Message is a native poll, information about the poll

venue.description: Message is a venue, information about the venue

MessageOrigin.description:
This object describes the origin of a message. It can be one of

- MessageOriginUser
- MessageOriginHiddenUser
- MessageOriginChat
- MessageOriginChannel

TextQuote.description: This object contains information about the quoted part of a message that is replied to by the given message.

text.description: Text of the quoted part of a message that is replied to by the given message

entities.description: Special entities that appear in the quote. Currently, only bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, spoiler, custom_emoji, and date_time entities are kept in quotes.

position.description: Approximate quote position in the original message in UTF-16 code units as specified by the sender

is_manual.description: True, if the quote was chosen manually by the message sender. Otherwise, the quote was added automatically by the server.

DirectMessagesTopic.description: Describes a topic of a direct messages chat.

user.description: Information about the user that created the topic. Currently, it is always present.

BusinessConnection.description: Describes the connection of the bot with a business account.

id.description: Unique identifier of the business connection

user.description: Business account user that created the business connection

user_chat_id.description: Identifier of a private chat with the user who created the business connection.

date.description: Date the connection was established in Unix time

is_enabled.description: True, if the connection is active

BusinessBotRights.description: Represents the rights of a business bot.

can_reply.description: True, if the bot can send and edit messages in the private chats that had incoming messages in the last 24 hours

can_read_messages.description: True, if the bot can mark incoming private messages as read

can_delete_outgoing_messages.description: True, if the bot can delete messages sent by the bot

can_delete_all_messages.description: True, if the bot can delete all private messages in managed chats

can_edit_name.description: True, if the bot can edit the first and last name of the business account

can_edit_bio.description: True, if the bot can edit the bio of the business account

can_edit_profile_photo.description: True, if the bot can edit the profile photo of the business account

can_edit_username.description: True, if the bot can edit the username of the business account

can_change_gift_settings.description: True, if the bot can change the privacy settings pertaining to gifts for the business account

can_view_gifts_and_stars.description: True, if the bot can view gifts and the amount of Telegram Stars owned by the business account

can_convert_gifts_to_stars.description: True, if the bot can convert regular gifts owned by the business account to Telegram Stars

can_transfer_and_upgrade_gifts.description: True, if the bot can transfer and upgrade gifts owned by the business account

can_transfer_stars.description: True, if the bot can transfer Telegram Stars received by the business account to its own account, or use them to upgrade and transfer gifts

can_manage_stories.description: True, if the bot can post, edit and delete stories on behalf of the business account

BusinessMessagesDeleted.description: This object is received when messages are deleted from a connected business account.

business_connection_id.description: Unique identifier of the business connection

chat.description: Information about a chat in the business account. The bot may not have access to the chat or the corresponding user.

message_ids.description: The list of identifiers of deleted messages in the chat of the business account

MessageGenerationStopped.description: This object describes an update about a user stopping message generation.

chat.description: Chat in which the message is generated

message_thread_id.description: Unique identifier of the message thread in which the message is generated

draft_id.description: Unique identifier of the message draft which was stopped

MessageReactionUpdated.description: This object represents a change of a reaction on a message performed by a user.

chat.description: The chat containing the message the user reacted to

message_id.description: Unique identifier of the message inside the chat

user.description: The user that changed the reaction, if the user isn't anonymous

actor_chat.description: The chat on behalf of which the reaction was changed, if the user is anonymous

date.description: Date of the change in Unix time

old_reaction.description: Previous list of reaction types that were set by the user

new_reaction.description: New list of reaction types that have been set by the user

MessageReactionCountUpdated.description: This object represents reaction changes on a message with anonymous reactions.

message_id.description: Unique message identifier inside the chat

date.description: Date of the change in Unix time

reactions.description: List of reactions that are present on the message

ReactionCount.description: Represents a reaction added to a message along with the number of times it was added.

total_count.description: Number of times the reaction was added

InlineQuery.description: This object represents an incoming inline query. When the user sends an empty query, your bot could return some default or trending results.

query.description: Text of the query (up to 256 characters)

offset.description: Offset of the results to be returned, can be controlled by the bot

chat_type.description: Type of the chat from which the inline query was sent. Can be either “sender” for a private chat with the inline query sender, “private”, “group”, “supergroup”, or “channel”.
