The chat type should be always known for requests sent from official clients and most third-party clients, unless the request was sent from a secret chat.

location.description: Sender location, only for bots that request user location

ChosenInlineResult.description:
Represents a result of an inline query that was chosen by the user and sent to their chat partner.

Note: It is necessary to enable inline feedback via `@BotFather` in order to receive these objects in updates.

result_id.description: The unique identifier for the result that was chosen

from.description: The user that chose the result

location.description: Sender location, only for bots that require user location

inline_message_id.description: Identifier of the sent inline message. Available only if there is an inline keyboard attached to the message. Will be also received in callback queries and can be used to edit the message.

query.description: The query that was used to obtain the result

CallbackQuery.description:
This object represents an incoming callback query from a callback button in an inline keyboard. If the button that originated the query was attached to a message sent by the bot, the field message will be present. If the button was attached to a message sent via the bot (in inline mode), the field inline_message_id will be present. Exactly one of the fields data or game_short_name will be present.

NOTE: After the user presses a callback button, Telegram clients will display a progress bar until you call answerCallbackQuery. It is, therefore, necessary to react by calling answerCallbackQuery even if no notification to the user is needed (e.g., without specifying any of the optional parameters).

message.description: Message sent by the bot with the callback button that originated the query

inline_message_id.description: Identifier of the message sent via the bot in inline mode, that originated the query

chat_instance.description: Global identifier, uniquely corresponding to the chat to which the message with the callback button was sent. Useful for high scores in games.

data.description: Data associated with the callback button. Be aware that the message originated the query can contain no callback buttons with this data.

game_short_name.description: Short name of a Game to be returned, serves as the unique identifier for the game

ShippingQuery.description: This object contains information about an incoming shipping query.

PreCheckoutQuery.description: This object contains information about an incoming pre-checkout query.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, or “XTR” for payments in Telegram Stars

total_amount.description: Total price in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of US$ 1.45 pass amount = 145. See the exp parameter in currencies.json, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).

shipping_option_id.description: Identifier of the shipping option chosen by the user

order_info.description: Order information provided by the user

PaidMediaPurchased.description: This object contains information about a paid media purchase.

PollAnswer.description: This object represents an answer of a user in a non-anonymous poll.

voter_chat.description: The chat that changed the answer to the poll, if the voter is anonymous

user.description: The user that changed the answer to the poll, if the voter isn't anonymous

option_ids.description: 0-based identifiers of chosen answer options. May be empty if the vote was retracted.

option_persistent_ids.description: Persistent identifiers of the chosen answer options. May be empty if the vote was retracted.

ChatMemberUpdated.description: This object represents changes in the status of a chat member.

from.description: Performer of the action, which resulted in the change

date.description: Date the change was done in Unix time

old_chat_member.description: Previous information about the chat member

new_chat_member.description: New information about the chat member

invite_link.description: Chat invite link, which was used by the user to join the chat; for joining by invite link events only

via_join_request.description: True, if the user joined the chat after sending a direct join request without using an invite link without using an invite link and being approved by an administrator

via_chat_folder_invite_link.description: True, if the user joined the chat via a chat folder invite link

ChatMember.description:
This object contains information about one member of a chat. Currently, the following 6 types of chat members are supported:
- ChatMemberOwner
- ChatMemberAdministrator
- ChatMemberMember
- ChatMemberRestricted
- ChatMemberLeft
- ChatMemberBanned

ChatMemberOwner.description: Represents a chat member that owns the chat and has all administrator privileges.

status.description: The member's status in the chat

is_anonymous.description: True, if the user's presence in the chat is hidden

ChatMemberAdministrator.description: Represents a chat member that has some additional privileges.

status.description: The member's status in the chat

can_be_edited.description: True, if the bot is allowed to edit administrator privileges of that user

is_anonymous.description: True, if the user's presence in the chat is hidden

can_manage_chat.description: True, if the administrator can access the chat event log, get boost list, see hidden supergroup and channel members, report spam messages, ignore slow mode, and send messages to the chat without paying Telegram Stars. Implied by any other administrator privilege.

can_delete_messages.description: True, if the administrator can delete messages of other users

can_manage_video_chats.description: True, if the administrator can manage video chats

can_restrict_members.description: True, if the administrator can restrict, ban or unban chat members, or access supergroup statistics

can_promote_members.description: True, if the administrator can add new administrators with a subset of their own privileges or demote administrators that they have promoted, directly or indirectly (promoted by administrators that were appointed by the user)

can_change_info.description: True, if the user is allowed to change the chat title, photo and other settings

can_invite_users.description: True, if the user is allowed to invite new users to the chat

can_manage_tags.description: True, if the administrator can edit the tags of regular members; for groups and supergroups only

can_post_stories.description: True, if the administrator can post stories to the chat

can_edit_stories.description: True, if the administrator can edit stories posted by other users, post stories to the chat page, pin chat stories, and access the chat's story archive

can_delete_stories.description: True, if the administrator can delete stories posted by other users

can_post_messages.description: True, if the administrator can post messages in the channel, approve suggested posts, or access channel statistics; for channels only

can_edit_messages.description: True, if the administrator can edit messages of other users and can pin messages; for channels only

can_pin_messages.description: True, if the user is allowed to pin messages; for groups and supergroups only

can_manage_topics.description: True, if the user is allowed to create, rename, close, and reopen forum topics; for supergroups only

can_manage_direct_messages.description: True, if the administrator can manage direct messages of the channel and decline suggested posts; for channels only

can_send_welcome_messages.description: True, if the administrator can manage chat welcome messages or directly send them in the case of bots

ChatMemberMember.description: Represents a chat member that has no additional privileges or restrictions.

status.description: The member's status in the chat

until_date.description: Date when the user's subscription will expire; Unix time

ChatMemberRestricted.description: Represents a chat member that is under certain restrictions in the chat. Supergroups only.

status.description: The member's status in the chat

is_member.description: True, if the user is a member of the chat at the moment of the request

can_send_messages.description: True, if the user is allowed to send text messages, rich messages, contacts, giveaways, giveaway winners, invoices, locations and venues

can_send_audios.description: True, if the user is allowed to send audios

can_send_documents.description: True, if the user is allowed to send documents

can_send_photos.description: True, if the user is allowed to send photos

can_send_videos.description: True, if the user is allowed to send videos

can_send_video_notes.description: True, if the user is allowed to send video notes

can_send_voice_notes.description: True, if the user is allowed to send voice notes

can_send_polls.description: True, if the user is allowed to send polls and checklists

can_send_other_messages.description: True, if the user is allowed to send animations, games, stickers and use inline bots

can_add_web_page_previews.description: True, if the user is allowed to add web page previews to their messages

can_react_to_messages.description: True, if the user is allowed to react to messages

can_change_info.description: True, if the user is allowed to change the chat title, photo and other settings

can_invite_users.description: True, if the user is allowed to invite new users to the chat

can_edit_tag.description: True, if the user is allowed to edit their own tag

can_pin_messages.description: True, if the user is allowed to pin messages

can_manage_topics.description: True, if the user is allowed to create forum topics

until_date.description: Date when restrictions will be lifted for this user; Unix time. If 0, then the user is restricted forever.

ChatMemberLeft.description: Represents a chat member that isn't currently a member of the chat, but may join it themselves.

status.description: The member's status in the chat

ChatMemberBanned.description: Represents a chat member that was banned in the chat and can't return to the chat or view chat messages.

status.description: The member's status in the chat

until_date.description: Date when restrictions will be lifted for this user; Unix time. If 0, then the user is banned forever.

ChatInviteLink.description: Represents an invite link for a chat.

invite_link.description: The invite link. If the link was created by another chat administrator, then the second part of the link will be replaced with "...".

creates_join_request.description: True, if users joining the chat via the link need to be approved by chat administrators

is_primary.description: True, if the link is primary

is_revoked.description: True, if the link is revoked

expire_date.description: Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the link will expire or has been expired

member_limit.description: The maximum number of users that can be members of the chat simultaneously after joining the chat via this invite link; 1-99999

pending_join_request_count.description: Number of pending join requests created using this link

subscription_period.description: The number of seconds the subscription will be active for before the next payment

subscription_price.description: The amount of Telegram Stars a user must pay initially and after each subsequent subscription period to be a member of the chat using the link

ChatJoinRequest.description: Represents a join request sent to a chat.

chat.description: Chat to which the request was sent

from.description: User that sent the join request

user_chat_id.description: Identifier of a private chat with the user who sent the join request. The bot can use this identifier for 5 minutes to send messages until the join request is processed, assuming no other administrator contacted the user.

date.description: Date the request was sent in Unix time

invite_link.description: Chat invite link that was used by the user to send the join request

query_id.description: Identifier of the join request query; for bots assigned to process join requests only. If present, then the bot must call sendChatJoinRequestWebApp or directly call answerChatJoinRequestQuery within 10 seconds.

ChatBoostUpdated.description: This object represents a boost added to a chat or changed.

ChatBoost.description: This object contains information about a chat boost.

add_date.description: Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the chat was boosted

expiration_date.description: Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the boost will automatically expire, unless the booster's Telegram Premium subscription is prolonged

ChatBoostSource.description:
This object describes the source of a chat boost. It can be one of

- ChatBoostSourcePremium
- ChatBoostSourceGiftCode
- ChatBoostSourceGiveaway

ChatBoostSourcePremium.description: The boost was obtained by subscribing to Telegram Premium or by gifting a Telegram Premium subscription to another user.

ChatBoostSourceGiftCode.description: The boost was obtained by the creation of Telegram Premium gift codes to boost a chat. Each such code boosts the chat 4 times for the duration of the corresponding Telegram Premium subscription.

user.description: User for which the gift code was created

ChatBoostSourceGiveaway.description: The boost was obtained by the creation of a Telegram Premium or a Telegram Star giveaway. This boosts the chat 4 times for the duration of the corresponding Telegram Premium subscription for Telegram Premium giveaways and prize_star_count / 500 times for one year for Telegram Star giveaways.

giveaway_message_id.description: Identifier of a message in the chat with the giveaway; the message could have been deleted already

user.description: User that won the prize in the giveaway if any; for Telegram Premium giveaways only

prize_star_count.description: The number of Telegram Stars to be split between giveaway winners; for Telegram Star giveaways only

is_unclaimed.description: True, if the giveaway was completed, but there was no user to win the prize

ChatBoostRemoved.description: This object represents a boost removed from a chat.

remove_date.description: Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the boost was removed

ManagedBotUpdated.description: This object contains information about the creation, token update, or owner update of a bot that is managed by the current bot.

bot.description: Information about the bot. Token of the bot can be fetched using the method getManagedBotToken.

BotSubscriptionUpdated.description: This object contains information about changes to a user payment subscription toward the current bot.

user.description: User who subscribed for payments toward the bot

state.description: The new state of the subscription. Currently, it can be one of “canceled” if the user canceled the subscription, “active” if the user re-enabled a previously canceled subscription, or “failed” if payment for the subscription failed.
